reel.caption:
Is your PF really tax-free if you withdraw it when you switch jobs?

A final PF withdrawal is tax-free only after 5 years of continuous service. Earlier jobs count only if you transferred the balance, not withdrew it.
Before 5 years, your own contribution stays exempt, but the interest and the employer's share are taxable.
Above ₹50,000, 10% TDS is cut if your PAN is linked (illustrative: up to ₹20,000 on ₹2 lakh). Below that there's no TDS, but tax may still be due.

Did you transfer your PF at your last job switch, or withdraw it?

Sources: a business news explainer on PF withdrawal tax (Jul 2026) and a bank's guide to PF withdrawal tax rules.
